lastSummary: NC-040 fixed: Retry and fallback behavior can multiply latency and cost. (1) New RetryBudget class in utils/retryBudget.ts — tracks total attempts across provider, router, and agent-loop layers with canAttempt()/recordAttempt() API. Default: 8 max attempts per agent turn. (2) RetryBudgetLike structural type added to ProviderGenerateOptions and ModelRequest in types.ts — keeps types.ts free of concrete imports. (3) ModelRouter.generate() and stream() check retryBudget.canAttempt() before each fallback candidate, skip candidates when exhausted, pass budget through to provider. (4) OpenAICompatibleProvider.fetchWithRetries() checks retryBudget.canAttempt() before HTTP retries and calls recordAttempt() after each fetch. (5) AgentLoop creates shared budget via createDefaultRetryBudget() per run, passes to all generate calls. (6) 10 regression tests in retryBudget.test.ts: unit tests for budget tracking/snapshot/config, ModelRouter integration tests for budget passthrough/exhaustion skipping/multiple candidates/backward compat. 1505/1505 tests pass. Build clean. All type-checks clean.
